annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/621 of 7 April 2022 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 as regards harmonised standards for truck mixers, cranes and other machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2022/621 of 7 April 2022 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 as regards harmonised standards for truck mixers, cranes and other machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 115/75
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision updating the list of harmonised standards under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, adding or replacing references for cranes, truck mixers, refuse vehicles and other machinery, restricting EN 474-1 for earth-moving machinery, and including EN 50636-2-107 on robotic lawnmowers. It confers presumption of conformity.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 harmonised standards list under Directive 2006/42/EC.
Publishes new references for cranes, truck mixers, refuse collection vehicles, woodworking machines and functional safety EN IEC 62061:2021.
Splits restrictions on EN 474-1:2006+A6:2019 into visibility and quick-coupler shortcomings.
Includes EN 50636-2-107 for robotic battery-powered lawnmowers; withdrawals deferred to 11 October 2023.
